query: How should a production RAG system detect unsupported claims?
answer: A production RAG system should compare generated claims against retrieved evidence, verify citation coverage, flag statements without supporting passages, and track hallucination risk as a regression metric across prompt and retriever versions.

retrieved_sources.title: RAG evaluation playbook
retrieved_sources.snippet: Unsupported claims should be flagged when generated assertions cannot be mapped to retrieved evidence chunks.

retrieved_sources.title: LLMOps monitoring guide
retrieved_sources.snippet: Grounding, citation coverage, and hallucination risk should be monitored across releases.

query: Why can keyword-only retrieval fail in technical support assistants?
answer: Keyword-only retrieval may miss semantically relevant documents when users describe the same issue with different vocabulary, abbreviations, or incomplete symptoms.

retrieved_sources.title: Search failure cases
retrieved_sources.snippet: Lexical search is sensitive to exact terminology and can miss semantically related passages.

retrieved_sources.title: Support assistant logs
retrieved_sources.snippet: Users often provide partial symptoms rather than exact product terms.

query: What does reranking add after hybrid retrieval?
answer: Reranking improves the ordering of candidate passages after broad retrieval. Hybrid search increases candidate recall, while reranking promotes the most answer-relevant evidence to the top context window.

retrieved_sources.title: Hybrid retrieval architecture
retrieved_sources.snippet: Hybrid retrieval is commonly used to maximize candidate coverage before a more precise ranking stage.

retrieved_sources.title: Reranking guide
retrieved_sources.snippet: Rerankers optimize passage order for relevance to the user question.

query: How can RAG dashboards expose cost and latency trade-offs?
answer: A RAG dashboard can expose latency and cost by recording retrieval time, reranking time, prompt token volume, completion tokens, total request duration, and estimated cost per query or per thousand queries.

retrieved_sources.title: Operational metrics for RAG
retrieved_sources.snippet: Token usage and request duration should be tracked by pipeline version.

retrieved_sources.title: LLM cost monitoring
retrieved_sources.snippet: Cost per query can be estimated from prompt tokens, completion tokens, and model pricing.

query: What is the main benefit of evaluating RAG before deployment?
answer: Pre-deployment RAG evaluation catches retrieval gaps, weak prompts, unsupported answers, and cost regressions before users rely on the system in production.

retrieved_sources.title: RAG release checklist
retrieved_sources.snippet: Evaluation before release reduces production hallucination and retrieval regressions.
